messages:
alex: quick heads-up — during the 2h long-context perf run on prod-like cluster we saw KV cache residency slowly drop and hit rate fall from 0.86 -> 0.62. creating thread to triage.

maya: I saw the same. eviction_count spiked ~10:14 UTC. snapshots attached to run #172. PromQL I used:
```
sum(rate(redwood_kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)
(sum(redwood_kv_resident_entries) / sum(redwood_kv_total_entries)) * 100
```

cheng: profiling indicates fragmentation growth in kv-heap segment; median entry size increases with long-contexts (more prefix tokens stored). quick flame: allocations trending up in kv::store::put path. suspect repeated small puts + variable entry sizes causing slab fragmentation and unusable holes.

oncall-bot: ALERT: kv_residency_pct < 70% for pool=gpu-2 for 12m. incident-id: INC-2026-482

sasha: Dashboard requests: add eviction_rate panel, residency_pct heatmap across pools, top-N keys by resident_size, and per-shard eviction counters. metric names proposal: redwood_kv_residency_bytes, redwood_kv_evictions_total, redwood_kv_fragmentation_ratio. Also add percentile of entry_size (p50/p95) to help spot growth.

ryan: Short-term mitigation: enable compaction job at lower threshold and bump kv pool memory cap for gpu-2. Proposed config snippet:
```
kv_compaction_interval: 10m
kv_compaction_threshold_pct: 15
kv_pool_memory_cap_mb: 24576
```
Will open a PR to toggle compaction.

alex: Action items: ryan -> push compaction toggle PR; cheng -> run targeted compaction test and attach before/after residency/hit-rate graphs; maya -> add panels (eviction_rate, residency_pct, frag_ratio); sasha -> draft dashboard layout; i'll open infra ticket and tag eng-runtime oncall. tl;dr: we need per-shard eviction counters, residency percent, fragmentation metric, and an alert for sustained hit-rate < 0.7. :thumbsup:
